personality_one_liner: A premium, highly-curated career intelligence platform that uses refined purple tones, spacious typography, and soft elevations to build immediate trust and value.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for a premium feel. Use md for inner component padding and xl for section dividers.

navigation: bottom_tabs for Candidate, drawer/stack for Admin

do's: Use glassmorphism on the locked-premium card overlay over the blurred job description.
Apply to sticky bottom CTA containers (e.g., 'Become a Member' button over scrolling content).
Use on the bottom tab bar.
dont's: Avoid on form inputs or standard list rows.

screens.name: Public Home
screens.purpose: Introduce the premium platform, explain value, and show membership options.
screens.layout: Hero image with gradient scrim and CTA overlay. Followed by a 'How it works' vertical step list, a 2-column grid of job categories, and a section displaying the 3 Membership Plans in horizontal scrolling cards.

screens.name: Explore Jobs
screens.purpose: List and filter curated job postings.

states.empty: Illustration with 'No matching jobs found. Try adjusting your filters.'
states.error: Failed to load jobs, retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with search bar and horizontally scrolling filter chips (brandTertiary tinted). List of Job Cards below. Job Cards should show company logo (left), Title and Location, with a 'Premium' lock icon if the user is a non-member.

screens.name: Job Detail
screens.purpose: Show details of a single job, gating premium info for non-members.
screens.layout: Hero section with Company Logo, Title, Location, and Date. Below, public info (Industry, Work Mode). For Non-Members: A heavily blurred content container with an absolute-positioned Glass panel overlay containing a Lock Icon, 'Premium Details Locked' text, and a sticky primary CTA to 'View Plans'. For Members: Full description, Recruiter Info card (surfaceSecondary), and an external 'Apply Now' CTA.

screens.name: Membership Plans
screens.purpose: Show pricing tiers and convert users to paid members.
screens.layout: Value proposition header. A vertical stack of pricing cards. Annual Plan is listed first and highlighted with a 'Best Value' / 'Recommended' badge (brandPrimary bg, white text) and a brandPrimary border. Includes a sticky full-width 'Continue to Payment' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Candidate Dashboard
screens.purpose: Manage membership, view saved jobs, and track payment history.
screens.layout: Top section: Membership Status Card. Background color dynamically maps to status (success/warning/error/info). Contains plan name, expiry countdown, and renew button. Middle section: Horizontal lists for 'Saved Jobs' and 'Recommended Jobs'. Bottom section: Payment history list.

screens.name: Admin Portal (Developer Panel)
screens.purpose: Manage platform data and simulate developer flows.
screens.layout: Dashboard grid of metrics. Dedicated Dev/Test panel screen with simple block buttons for actions like 'Simulate Successful Payment', 'Expire Account Now', 'Activate 90-day plan' for easy testing.

empty_state_minimal.alt: Soft white fabric background for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the EevolveX Purple theme constraints. #6D28D9 is the brand base. Avoid all blues and neons.

Implement the gated content pattern correctly on the Job Detail screen: For non-members, use a heavily blurred container over the private text with a Glass CTA overlay containing a lock icon. Do not leak the private text in the DOM/UI if possible, or heavily obscure it.
Membership plans should prioritize the Annual tier. Make it visually distinct by default-selecting it, adding a 'Best Value' pill badge, and applying a borderStrong or brandPrimary border around it.

Candidate Dashboard MUST have a dynamic status card. Map its background color to the 'success', 'warning', 'error', or 'info' tokens respectively for Active, Expiring, Expired, and No Membership statuses.
All branded company listings (Google, Microsoft, etc.) must use the fetched images (company_google, company_microsoft, etc.).
Ensure touch targets for filter chips and buttons are at least 44x44pt.
For the Developer Test Panel, build a simple, utilitarian UI separate from the premium candidate experience to allow toggling subscription states instantly for QA.
